descriptor.name: Ville de Longueuil municipal cadastral lots
descriptor.scope: Municipal cadastral lot polygons in publisher-coded official states -1 and 0; bounded Longueuil neighborhood qualification only. Service extent may span the municipal agglomeration; citywide completeness and authoritative maintenance scope remain unverified.
descriptor.licenceNote: No reuse licence is established in the frozen packet or inspected service schema; legal and licence review remain for primary review.

evidence: The frozen city packet and service review identify the city-operated municipal Cadastre polygon layer at https://geomatique.longueuil.quebec/public/rest/services/DonneesPubliques/CadastreEtEvaluation/FeatureServer/0 and native cadastral lot NUMERO 2 798 557 intersecting the exact Longueuil WUP locator.

Official City of Longueuil interactive-map page links its GeoHub for maps and open data; the inspected service separates cadastral lots from assessment-unit geometry and supplies official/future cadastral status codes. See evidence/source-purpose.json, layer-schema.json, service-schema.json and exact-count.json.

Official Quebec cadastral guidance identifies cadastral plans as representation of land properties with distinct native lot numbers: https://www.quebec.ca/habitation-territoire/information-fonciere/cadastre/consulter-cadastre . Geographic assertion is bounded local Longueuil coverage, not province-wide or citywide completeness.
